name: Madame Ro's Curiosity Quiz
source:
On one of your regular walks you stumble upon a strange tent, and an even stranger woman inside of it who wants to learn more about you...

Madame Ro's Curiosity Quiz is a personality quiz-style visual novel. Players will answer several questions from the titular character, Madame Ro, and at the end are presented a previous visitor who may or may not resemble the player based on their answers. This quiz is purely for fun.

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/madame-ro]itch.io[/url]]
